title: Peeliya (Jaundice) Ka Test — Bilirubin Aur LFT, Deoria
description: Peeliya me kaun se test karayein — bilirubin, LFT, hepatitis A, B, C, E, bilirubin ki normal range, kab turant aspataal, aur Deoria me jaundice test ghar par.
keywords: peeliya kitne din me theek hota hai
takeaways: Peeliya khud bimari nahi, lakshan hai — khoon me bilirubin badhne se aankh aur chamdi peeli hoti hai. Test ka kaam ye dhoondhna hai ki bilirubin kyun badha.
Pehli jaanch: LFT (total, direct aur indirect bilirubin, SGPT, SGOT), CBC aur urine. Phir kaaran ke liye hepatitis A, E, B aur C.
Barsaat aur baadh ke baad Deoria me peeliya ka sabse aam kaaran gande paani se hepatitis A aur E hai — ye aksar 4-8 hafte me theek ho jaata hai.
Pregnancy me peeliya, bahut susti ya uljhan, khoon ki ulti, ya naye janme bachche me pehle 24 ghante me peelapan — turant aspataal.

sections.heading: Peeliya Kya Hai — Aankh Aur Peshab Peela Kyun Hota Hai
sections.lead: Jaanch se pehle ye samajhna zaroori hai ki peeliya ek lakshan hai.
blocks: Khoon ke purane laal cells tootte hain to bilirubin naam ka peela padaarth banta hai. Liver ise saaf karta hai aur pitt (bile) ke raaste pet me bhej deta hai. Is raaste me kahin bhi rukawat ho — laal cells zyada tootein, liver kamzor ho, ya pitt ki nali band ho — to bilirubin khoon me jama hone lagta hai. Sabse pehle aankhon ka safed hissa peela hota hai, phir chamdi, aur peshab gehra peela ya chai ke rang ka.

Deoria aur Purvanchal me peeliya ko aam bol-chaal me ek hi bimari maana jaata hai, aur kai log jhaad-phoonk ya desi nuskhe se ilaaj karte hain. Lekin peeliya ke peeche kai alag kaaran ho sakte hain — kuch apne aap theek hone wale, kuch gambhir. Blood test hi batata hai ki kaun sa hai.

note.title: Desi dawa se pehle jaanch
note.text: Kai jadi-booti aur 'peeliya utaarne' wali dawaiyan khud liver ko nuksan pahunchaati hain. Koi bhi ilaaj shuru karne se pehle LFT aur doctor ki salah lijiye.

sections.heading: Barsaat Aur Baadh Ke Baad Peeliya — Hepatitis A Aur E
sections.lead: Deoria me peeliya ke zyadatar maamle paani se aate hain.
blocks: Ghaghra aur Chhoti Gandak ke kinaare ke ilaakon me barsaat aur baadh ke baad handpump aur kuon ka paani aksar gandaa ho jaata hai. Hepatitis A aur E isi paani aur khule khaane se failte hain. Shuruaat bukhar, bhookh na lagna, ulti aur thakan se hoti hai, aur kuch din baad aankh-peshab peele hote hain.

list: Hepatitis A bachchon me zyada aur aksar halka hota hai; vayaskon me thoda lamba chalta hai.
Hepatitis E zyadatar 4-8 hafte me khud theek ho jaata hai — lekin pregnant mahilaon me ye gambhir ho sakta hai.
Dono me aaraam, paani aur halka khaana hi mukhya ilaaj hai; koi khaas dawa nahi hoti.
Ghar me ek ko hua ho to baaki log ubla ya saaf paani piyein aur haath dhone par dhyaan dein.

note.title: Pregnancy me peeliya — usi din aspataal
note.text: Pregnancy me hepatitis E khatarnak ho sakta hai. Garbhvati mahila me aankh ya peshab peela ho to ghar par intezaar mat kijiye — usi din aspataal ya gynaecologist ke paas jaaiye.

sections.heading: Peeliya Me Kab Turant Aspataal Jaayein
sections.lead: Zyadatar peeliya ghar par aaraam se theek hota hai. Ye lakshan us zyadatar me nahi aate.

note.title: Khatre ke lakshan
note.text: Bahut susti, neend jaisi behoshi, uljhan ya ulti-seedhi baatein; khoon ki ulti ya kaale dast; masoodon ya naak se khoon; peshab bahut kam; lagatar ulti aur kuch na pacha paana; pregnancy me peeliya; ya naye janme bachche me pehle 24 ghante me peelapan — in me se kuch bhi ho to turant aspataal.

sections.heading: Peeliya Kitne Din Me Theek Hota Hai — Test Kab Dohrayein
sections.lead: Aankh ka peelapan sabse aakhir me jaata hai. Report pehle sudharti hai.

faqs.question: Peeliya me kaun sa test karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Pehle LFT (total, direct aur indirect bilirubin, SGPT, SGOT, ALP), CBC aur urine routine. Phir kaaran ke liye hepatitis A (Anti-HAV IgM), hepatitis E (Anti-HEV IgM), HBsAg aur Anti-HCV. Bukhar ho to malaria aur typhoid bhi.

faqs.question: Bilirubin ki normal range kya hai?
faqs.answer: Vayaskon me total bilirubin aam taur par 0.3 se 1.2 mg/dL aur direct bilirubin 0.3 mg/dL tak hota hai. Aankh me peelapan aam taur par total bilirubin 2.5-3 se upar hone par dikhta hai. Apni report ki range hi maaniye.

faqs.question: Direct aur indirect bilirubin me kya farak hai?
faqs.answer: Indirect bilirubin wo hai jo liver ne abhi saaf nahi kiya; direct wo jo liver ne saaf kar diya. Indirect zyada badha ho to laal cells ka tootna ya Gilbert syndrome; direct zyada badha ho to liver ya pitt ki nali ki dikkat ka ishaara hota hai.

faqs.question: Peeliya kitne din me theek hota hai?
faqs.answer: Hepatitis A aur E wala peeliya aam taur par 2 se 8 hafte me theek ho jaata hai. SGPT pehle girta hai, bilirubin dheere, aur aankh ka peelapan sabse aakhir me jaata hai. Doctor aam taur par hafte-das din me LFT dohraate hain.

faqs.question: Pregnancy me peeliya ho to kya karein?
faqs.answer: Usi din aspataal ya gynaecologist ke paas jaaiye. Pregnancy me hepatitis E gambhir ho sakta hai, isliye ghar par intezaar mat kijiye.

faqs.question: Deoria me peeliya ka test ghar par ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. LFT, CBC aur urine ka sample Deoria Sadar, Rudrapur, Barhaj, Salempur, Bhatpar Rani, Gauri Bazar, Baitalpur, Lar aur Bhatni me ghar par liya jaata hai. Fasting nahi chahiye, report 24 ghante ke andar WhatsApp par.
